title: Utility Order for Louisiana Public Service Commission, ex parte. — Order No. U-37603 accepts the Joint Report and Draft Order filed into the record on October 5, 2026. Commission consideration occurred at the October 22, 2026 Business and Executive Session.

documents.text:
LOUISIANA PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
                                  ORDER NUMBER U-37603

               LOUISIANA PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION, EX PARTE.

Docket No. U-37603, In re: Audit of Purchase Gas Adjustment filings for the natural gas
division of Entergy Louisiana, LLC for the period of January 2023 through June 30, 2025.

               (Decided at the October 22, 2026 Business and Executive Session.)


                                             ORDER

Overview

       This Commission, having reviewed and considered the Joint Report and Draft Order

(“Joint Report”) filed by the Staff of the Louisiana Public Service Commission (“LPSC Staff”)

and Entergy Louisiana, LLC (“ELL”), finds said Joint Report to be acceptable and in accordance

with the provisions of the Commission’s General Order dated March 24, 1999 (“1999 General

Order”). The Joint Report was filed into the record on March 11, 2026.

       The Joint Report, which resolved all issues in this matter found that the costs included in

ELL’s Purchased Gas Adjustment (“PGA”) filings (1) were reasonable, prudent and necessary for

the provision of service to its customers; (2) were in compliance with the requirements of the 1999

General Order and other relevant Commission Orders, and; (3) were eligible for recovery through

the PGA recovery mechanism.

Jurisdiction

       The Commission exercises jurisdiction over public utilities in Louisiana pursuant to Article

IV, Section 21(B) of the Louisiana Constitution, which states:

               The commission shall regulate all common carries and public
               utilities and have such other regulatory authority as provided by law.
               It shall adopt and enforce reasonable rules, regulations and
               procedures necessary for the discharge of its duties and shall have
               other powers and perform other duties as provided by law.

       Consistent with that authority, the Commission adopted the 1999 General Order, which

developed standards governing the ratemaking treatment of purchased gas costs incurred by gas

utilities operating within the State of Louisiana, as well as all addressed issues concerning costs

eligible for recovery through the cost of PGA mechanisms and to standardize various reporting

and review requirements.




                                                                               Order No. U-37603
                                                                                          Page 1
 Commission Consideration

       This matter was considered at the Commission’s October 22, 2026 Business and Executive

Session. On motion of Chairman Skrmetta, seconded by Vice Chairman Coussan, and

unanimously adopted, the Commission voted to accept the Joint Report and Draft Order filed into

the record on October 5, 2026.

THEREFORE, IT IS ORDERED:

   1) That the Joint Report filed by ELL and Commission Staff is accepted.

   2) The costs included in the PGA filings of ELL during the audit period were reasonable,

       prudent, and necessary to the provision of service for jurisdictional retail customers.

   3) The costs included in the PGA filings of ELL qualified for recovery under the PGA

       mechanism.



This Order is effective immediately.

BY ORDER OF THE COMMISSION
BATON ROUGE, LOUISIANA
November 19, 2026
